readme: Example real-code target manifest for the engine-quality study (Experiment 1,
issue #85). Loaded by trade_study.py --manifest. Paths resolve relative to this
file's directory unless absolute. Only the 'targets' array is parsed; this
'readme' and the 'runnable_target_shape' block below are documentation.
Every target below is a maintained real-code benchmark pinned to an upstream
{url, commit}. They ship as status='requires_build_recipe' because the study's
single clang/afl-cc/hfuzz-cc invocation cannot configure an arbitrary project
build; they appear as VISIBLE 'unsupported' rows until a maintainer wires them.
<dir>` to clone each upstream at its pin; (2) add a small adapter .c that includes
the library header and defines int target_one_input(const unsigned char*, size_t)
calling the pinned API; (3) set 'sources' to [adapter.c, <needed project .c files>]
and 'include_dirs' to the project include paths (absolute, or under <dir>);
(4) set status='runnable'. Keep bhf_harness_mode='provided' so the harness is held
fixed across engines (see METHODOLOGY.md for wiring the bhf provided-harness CLI).

runnable_target_shape.name: example-lib
runnable_target_shape.expected_oracle: any ASan/UBSan diagnostic on a confirmed defect
runnable_target_shape.notes: the adapter must define target_one_input; one source may instead define it directly

targets.name: cjson
targets.description: cJSON_ParseWithLengthOpts — small single-TU JSON parser, canonical fuzz target
targets.expected_oracle: any ASan/UBSan diagnostic (heap-overflow/UAF) on a parsed input
targets.notes: runnable as a 1-TU target: adapter + cJSON.c, include_dirs=[checkout]. Primary single-file example.

targets.name: zlib
targets.expected_oracle: any ASan/UBSan diagnostic on a decompressed stream
targets.notes: needs the zlib .c set + zconf.h generated by configure; supply a build recipe or a prebuilt object set.

targets.name: libpng
targets.notes: depends on zlib and pnglibconf.h; requires a project build recipe.

targets.name: libyaml
targets.expected_oracle: any ASan/UBSan diagnostic while parsing events
targets.notes: needs src/*.c and config.h from autogen; supply a build recipe.

targets.name: re2
targets.description: re2::Regexp::Parse — C++ regex engine (Abseil transitive deps)
targets.expected_oracle: any ASan/UBSan diagnostic while parsing a pattern
targets.notes: C++ target with an Abseil build closure; requires a full project/CMake build recipe.

targets.name: sqlite
targets.description: sqlite3_prepare_v2 — SQL statement compiler (amalgamation is single-TU)
targets.expected_oracle: any ASan/UBSan diagnostic while preparing a statement
targets.notes: the amalgamation (sqlite3.c, generated by `make sqlite3.c`) is a single TU and is the closest real-code target to a runnable 1-TU build.
